rows.note: Use this for careless, messy or hard-to-read writing rather than a doodle.

example.english: You wrote your homework in such a scribble that I can’t read it at all.
example.traditional: 你份功課啲字寫到鬼畫符咁，我完全睇唔明。

rows.note: Use this when a scribble is a doodle or casual drawing, rather than messy handwriting.

example.english: This sheet of drawing paper is covered in the child’s scribble.
example.traditional: 呢張畫紙畀個小朋友畫到周圍都係塗鴉。
